desc: Newspaper Publication of Information regarding 40th Annual General Meeting of the Company.
Newspaper Publication - Notice of 40th Annual General Meeting

Nova Iron & Steel Ltdhas informed BSE that the meeting of the Board of Directors of the Company is scheduled on 11/09/2026 ,inter alia, to consider and approve the Unaudited Financial Results of the Company for the quarter ended 30th June, 2026.
